correctness.rationale: The Hessian identity, resultant, four cyclotomic solutions, exact minimal polynomials, discriminants, and pairwise resultants are replayed in VERIFY.py. They prove all 24 simple geometric flex points persist over every prime p>=5 except 7. Frobenius zeta_7->zeta_7^p then yields all four cycle types. The algebraic argument (Bezout) converts finite certificates to a universal assertion.

value.rationale: The full arithmetic classification of a canonical 24-point flex/Weierstrass divisor over all good odd primes is a motivated complete family, sharpening the classical 24-point complex orbit and isolated characteristic-five arithmetic case. It gives every field-extension point count and the exact common cyclotomic splitting degree, with an integral uniform reduction certificate. This is more than a single arbitrary finite computation.
